description: This file defines an abstract class 'NotesApi' that specifies the contract for remote API interactions related to notes, including methods to push notes and fetch notes updated since a given timestamp.

classes.name: NotesApi
classes.description: An abstract class that declares methods for interacting with remote notes data, including pushing a list of notes and fetching notes updated since a specific timestamp.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously pushes a list of Notes to the remote server.

methods.name: fetchNotesUpdatedSince
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches notes that have been updated since the provided timestamp (in milliseconds since epoch).
